mathematics.assertion_tested: Same fixed MW jet/decomposition controls, plus independent matrix/rank-one high-k criterion under explicitly stated hydrostatic isotropic barotropic two-gas-fluid closure. Record restoring-force sign rather than assume it; report lack of positive-compressibility barotropic closure where required cs²<=0. Matrix/rank-one equivalence only used for positive cs².
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE754 float64 and sparse weighted adjoints
mathematics.conventions: Gradients in a0 units, Hessian a0/kpc, N in kpc². Full physical model unchanged. N is local continuum frozen-coefficient response; criticalspeeds are one-fluid or gas-only pressure thresholds, not measured velocitydispersions. Required gas sound speeds inferred from fixed density gradients and full vertical force, not adopted measurements. Stars fixed in perturbation; short-wave vertical modes only.
inputs: Analytic N=.5E_HH[nn,nn] and Euler-continuity WKB relation
non_claims: No new empirical fit or cutoff
No observed gaspressure or collisionless dispersion supplied
Finite jets do not prove global nonlinear stability
A-only/B-only potentials are diagnostic pieces of one fullresponse, not newphysicalmodels
No general MHD, collisionless or relativistic stability result; no fitted pressure or asserted observed gas speed.
